title: Step 39 known-answer calibration for compact toric period defects
scope: Execution audit for the collapsed positive toric subroute; not a proof/refutation of Yau-26.
main_corrections_to_step38: Same-circle rod multiplicity is not an obstruction by itself: S2xS2, Page/F1, CLW/dP2, and toric KE dP3 are exact positive Einstein calibrations with repeated unoriented rod classes.

The noncompact finite Weyl-chain period mismatch does not transfer directly to compact polygons: the compact rectangle/product metric has zero defect although the noncompact 4-rod chain has exp-range 3/2.

Step 15/17 μ=1 iff A=0 is a separated SdS/cohomogeneity-one theorem, not a theorem for arbitrary compact two-same-circle toric polygons; Page is the calibration showing two same-circle rods can close with K_B not identically zero.
At m=6 one must distinguish the known toric KE dP3 hexagon (three classes, two rods each, defect zero) from the alternating spin #2(S2xS2) hexagon (two classes, three rods each, unknown).

Any exact-Einstein compact toric obstruction must be formulated as a defect vector on a relaxed boundary-value problem and must have a quantitative margin before it says anything about C0 Ricci-pinched, non-Einstein metrics.

toric_energy_budget_correction_to_step38.toric_four_manifold_euler_characteristic: chi equals number of polygon vertices/edges m, not m+2
toric_energy_budget_correction_to_step38.chern_gauss_bonnet_budget_for_near_posit: 8*pi^2 * chi = 8*pi^2 * m plus lower-order tracefree-Ricci corrections in the normalized convention
toric_energy_budget_correction_to_step38.consequence: The Step-38 data claim of universal 16*pi^2 slack from chi=m+2 is false for closed toric 4-polygons. If the per-rod 8*pi^2 quantum is independent of corner/collar energy, the budget is saturated and any extra positive O(1) contribution per cell would matter.
toric_energy_budget_correction_to_step38.remaining_uncertainty: Whether the per-rod 8*pi^2 quantum already includes the correct corner/collar pieces remains a geometric decomposition question; the correction here is the topology chi=m.

fan_calibrations.name: CP2 / Fubini-Study
fan_calibrations.known_status: exact positive Kähler-Einstein; no repeated unoriented circle class
fan_calibrations.source: standard toric fan; Liu source lists Fubini-Study among known toric Einstein examples

fan_calibrations.name: S2xS2 / product rectangle
fan_calibrations.known_status: exact positive product Einstein; two same-circle pairs; compact period defect must vanish
fan_calibrations.source: standard product fan; Liu/Hall-Murphy known examples

fan_calibrations.name: F1 = CP2#CPbar / Page (one common fan convention)
fan_calibrations.known_status: exact positive Einstein Page metric; non-Kähler Hermitian; T2-invariant; one same-circle pair
fan_calibrations.source: Liu lines 37-41; Hall-Murphy lines on Page U(2) and toric-Kähler conformal metric

fan_calibrations.name: dP2 = CP2#2CPbar / Chen-LeBrun-Weber
fan_calibrations.known_status: exact positive Einstein CLW metric; T2-invariant; two independent same-circle pairs
fan_calibrations.source: Hall-Murphy section 3 pentagon inequalities; Liu known examples

fan_calibrations.name: dP3 = CP2#3CPbar / toric Kähler-Einstein hexagon
fan_calibrations.known_status: exact positive Kähler-Einstein toric metric; three same-circle pairs, but no class has three rods
fan_calibrations.source: Liu known examples; standard toric del Pezzo hexagon

fan_calibrations.name: alternating spin hexagon candidate (#2(S2xS2) label pattern)
fan_calibrations.known_status: no known Einstein metric; three rods in each of two circle classes; this is the first alternating stress case not settled by known examples
fan_calibrations.source: session Step 18/25/38 label family; not a convex toric del Pezzo fan

base_gauss_bonnet.interpretation: Page reproduces ∫K_B=0 for a right-angled quadrilateral while K_B is not identically zero.

r_edges_collapsing_(1,0).note: Equality of the two same-circle r-edge slopes is the meaningful calibration here; unit value depends on Euler-angle/primitive-period convention. The common U(2)-basis value is exactly 1+nu from the Page formula.

safe_variables: cyclic primitive labels modulo GL(2,Z) and sign of each label
edge curvature profile, not only constant A
rod lengths and surface gravities before unit-slope imposition
two circle rescalings and overall scale gauge
Ricci defect δ if passing from exact Einstein to pinched metrics
unsafe_shortcuts: using noncompact finite-chain exp-ranges as compact defects
using the separated SdS μ(A) as a universal two-rod obstruction
perturbing the alternating m=6 candidate around A=0, since no such background solution is known
